s09efc1bdc7e378: Before that, explain briefly what Kernel is.
sfb945dfe9c9cd8: In the CUDA programming, Kernel is a function performed in parallel on GPU. Developer prepares Kernel to describe the parallel calculation task and then calls Kernel on the host to perform calculations on GPU.
s0b6bfdaa0bfac2: In the CUDA program structure, the host code part is executed on the CPU and is a normal C code. When encountered with the data in parallel processing, CUDA compiles the program into a program that GPU can execute and transmits to GPU, which is called kernel in the CUDA. The device code part is performed on the GPU and this code part is written on Kernel (.cu file).
s9bb5571801d08b: The real utilization of GPU is the submission of a one-size-fits-all calculation task to GPU, possibly any parallel computing tasks such as matrix multiplication, volume operation, vector addition, which is referred to as kernel above.
